tools.name: get_unity_errors
tools.description: Retrieves Unity console error logs with optional filtering by severity, count limit, and time range. Returns error messages, stack traces, and timestamps.

severity.description: Filter logs by severity level. Use 'all' to retrieve all types.

limit.description: Maximum number of log entries to return, ordered by most recent first.

since.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp. Only return logs that occurred after this time. Omit to get all logs.

examples.description: Get up to 10 logs of any severity since 2:30 PM UTC
Get the default 100 most recent logs of all types

tools.name: clear_error_log
tools.description: Clears all buffered error logs from memory. This action cannot be undone. Use when starting a fresh debugging session or when buffer is full.

confirm.description: Must be set to true to confirm clearing all logs. Prevents accidental data loss.

examples.description: Clear all error logs from buffer

tools.name: get_server_status
tools.description: Retrieves the current MCP server operational status, including buffer statistics, active sessions, and configuration details. Useful for diagnosing connectivity issues.

activeSessions.description: Number of currently connected MCP clients

bufferSize.description: Current number of errors in buffer

totalErrorsCaptured.description: Lifetime count of errors captured since server start

lastErrorTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent error, or null if no errors

isCapturing.description: Whether the server is actively capturing new errors

examples.description: Get current server status and diagnostics

tools.name: subscribe_error_notifications
tools.description: [PRIORITY 3] Subscribe to real-time error notifications via server-sent events (SSE). When new errors occur in Unity, the server will push notifications to the client. Requires MCP client to support SSE.

severityFilter.description: Array of severity levels to receive notifications for. Empty array means all severities.

examples.description: Subscribe to notifications for errors and exceptions only
Subscribe to notifications for all error types

tools.name: unsubscribe_error_notifications
tools.description: [PRIORITY 3] Unsubscribe from real-time error notifications. Stops the server from sending push notifications to this client session.
